features.name: Credential Manager: "Both" checkbox to create users in the workspace and a portal
features.description: Feature Properties → Use as Credential Manager → "Create users in" has a new "Both"; checkbox on the right. When checked, Workspace and Portal are both selected, a portal must be; picked, and every record creates a workspace user and a portal user. The mapping list shows; separate "Workspace Roles" and "Portal Roles" fields (plus Portal Category), and there are two; default-role lists: Default Workspace Role(s) and Default Portal Role(s). Checking or unchecking; "Both" clears the role mappings and default roles, because their meaning changes. Portal sign-up; settings list "Both" features for their portal.
features.impact: The same user sometimes needs to be created in both places at once, with different roles.

enhancements.description: The Settings → **Row actions** section is removed, along with everything it set: show or hide Add / Edit / Delete, Add position, new row at top, ask before deleting, Save each row / Save with, the table's words and colours, and button looks. The definition table again has its fixed "+ Add definition" (runtime only, not drawn on the builder canvas), pencil, bin and words, as before 2026-11-10. **Kept:** a record opened in **View** shows no Add, Edit or Delete (before 2026-11-10 they still worked there).
enhancements.benefit: Add, Edit and Delete already existed. The extra settings were not needed: of 318 definition tables on the UAT host, none had any of them saved, and the address page saves with the page's own Save button.

enhancements.description: Table → Settings → **Add Button** (Definition tables only): Button text, Button colour, Text colour. Empty keeps "Add definition", the brand colour and white text. The Settings panel now reads the table type the same way the table does (`resolveTableKind`), so sections shown only for a table type also appear when the type is saved only under `table.source.tableType`. An empty colour in a seeded colour field shows "Default" instead of "#000000".
enhancements.benefit: The button's words and colours were fixed.

Built-in templates now refresh on seed, so a corrected template reaches existing databases — Two changes to the built-in catalogue.; 1. **Content fix.** The "Count child records" template inserted `COUNT_RECORDS()`. The validator; requires at least one argument, so using it produced *"Function COUNT_RECORDS expects at least 1; arguments, but got 0"* every time. It now inserts `COUNT_RECORDS({id})`.; 2. **Seeding fix.** `seedBuiltIns` used `update: { $setOnInsert: ... }`, which writes a built-in once; and never again. Once a database had seeded the old text, the row existed, the update matched; nothing to do, and correcting `BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES` had no effect — which is why QA still saw; `COUNT_RECORDS()` after the template was fixed in code. Content fields (`category`,; `description`, `formula`, `explanation`, `useWhen`, `tags`) are now refreshed on every boot;; `$setOnInsert` still covers first creation.
QA-reported NB-12. Also explains a class of bug where a built-in template edit appears to; do nothing in the running product.

Help, examples and templates now match the engine (NB-12) — Every entry that named a formula function differently from how the engine actually; behaves has been corrected, in three places: **Help / Cheat Sheet** (`formulaHelpData.ts`), the; *Examples** panel (`formulaExamples.ts`), and the **Operators and Functions** tooltip; (`OperatorsAndFunctionsTab.tsx`).; | Entry | Said | Now says |; | --- | --- | --- |; | `COUNT_RECORDS` | `COUNT_RECORDS()` | `COUNT_RECORDS({field})` — the field argument is required |; | `COUNT_RECORDS` with filter | filter shown as the **first** argument | `COUNT_RECORDS({field}, {key} == value)` |; | `DAY_OF_WEEK` | "1=Monday … 7=Sunday" | returns the day **name** — `"Sunday"` … `"Saturday"` |; | `MIN_OF_RECORDS` | example used a **date** field | numeric only; a date is coerced and returns `0` |; | `CONTAINS` | third argument not mentioned | documents the optional `caseSensitive`, default **case-sensitive** |; | Examples — "Count all child records" | `COUNT_RECORDS()` | `COUNT_RECORDS({id})` |; | Examples — "Count with condition" | `COUNT_RECORDS({status} == "completed")` | `COUNT_RECORDS({id}, {status} == "completed")` |

QA filed this as NB-12. The template "Count child records" inserted `COUNT_RECORDS()`,; which the validator rejects outright — *"Function COUNT_RECORDS expects at least 1 arguments, but; got 0"*. The cheatsheet said `DAY_OF_WEEK` returned a number and it returns text. Nothing in the; engine changed; the help was describing a different engine than the one that runs.
configChanges: Draft & Publish switched off: Key Mapping saves go live

New switch `KBD_SHORTCUTS_DRAFT_PUBLISH_ENABLED` (default **false**). While off, every shortcut save is live immediately, whatever mode a tenant had chosen; `/settings` reports `publishMode: 'direct'` and `draftPublishEnabled: false`; switching a tenant to Draft & Publish is refused (400). Set it to `true` to bring back Draft & Publish, Versions and rollback.
Product owner request: only "Save Changes", no Publish step.
Gateway pointed backup requests at the chat service on dev

`.env.production` had `BACKUP_SERVICE_URL=http://cadp-backend-chat.cadp-dev.svc.cluster.local/backup-service` — the chat service's host. It now names the backup service: `http://cadp-backend-backup.cadp-dev.svc.cluster.local/backup-service` (matches `k8s/dev/service.yaml` in the backup repo). The dev deployment also reads the `cadp-dev-env` Key Vault secret, which takes precedence; check its `BACKUP_SERVICE_URL` too.
On dev every backup screen showed "The backup service is currently unavailable" (the gateway's 503 when it can't reach the service).
